title: ESA and Mistral Partner to Explore Space AI
summary: The European Space Agency and Mistral signed an agreement to increase the role of AI in space.

title: Dutch Students Build EV Concept That Captures Tire and Brake Emissions
summary: A team of Dutch students designed an EV concept that uses a static charge to capture microplastic shedding from tires and brakes.

title: Micron Reports $54B Revenue Quarter
summary: Micron announced revenue of $54.23 billion for calendar Q3.

title: Advantech Launches Robot Controller SBCs
summary: Advantech introduced the ASR-A503 robot controller single-board computer and AFE-A503 industrial robot controller powered by the Qualcomm processor.

title: Galileo Space Builds Orbit-Processing Satellites
summary: Galileo Space is building satellites designed to turn signals into answers directly in orbit.

title: Carbon Content Modulation Improves NMOSFET Electron Mobility
summary: Reducing carbon content in the silicon nitride spacer of NMOSFETs by 2% enhances electron mobility and performance by 6%.

title: Optimized EBL Structure Enhances Light Output in GaN LEDs
summary: Embedding an intralayer potential barrier in a wide electron-blocking layer significantly increases the light output power and external quantum efficiency of InGaN/GaN LEDs.

title: Enhanced Water Temperature Model for Aqueducts
summary: A new one-dimensional calculation model incorporating aqueduct orientation and water surface shading reduces water temperature prediction error by 65%.

title: EduCase Framework for Engineering Education
summary: Researchers introduce the EduCase framework, a multiphase structured approach for developing and refining educational case studies in engineering.

title: Social Presence AR Tool Enhances Online Learning
summary: A study shows that integrating real-time voice chat and augmented reality significantly improves student engagement and comprehension in online engineering courses.

title: New Limit Equilibrium Solution for Bucket Foundations
summary: This paper presents a new limit equilibrium solution for the ultimate bearing capacity of bucket foundations in sand under combined loading.

title: AAS and AML Framework for Automation Engineering
summary: An article proposes a method to integrate AutomationML engineering data into the Asset Administration Shell to enable cross-domain collaboration.

title: Study Uncovers Efficiency-Throughput Gap with Copilot
summary: A real-world field study finds that GitHub Copilot improves individual developer efficiency without producing statistically significant gains in organizational throughput.

title: Project-Based Learning in Crisis Conditions
summary: Research demonstrates that project-based learning successfully sustained learning quality and improved exam averages for mechanics students during national crises.

title: Sampled-Data Control of MIMO Fractional-Order Systems
summary: This work investigates sampled-data control of fractional-order multiple-input-multiple-output systems by linking the state-transition matrix image and input gain kernel.

title: Geometric Reconstruction for Buckled Steel Members
summary: Researchers propose a geometric reconstruction method using point cloud models to evaluate the residual load-carrying capacity of locally buckled steel members.

title: Cooperative Yaw Predictive Control for Wind Farms
summary: A continuous learning framework using SCADA data is proposed to improve model adaptability and performance in wind farm cooperative yaw control.

title: System Dynamics Simulation for Design Scheduling
summary: A system dynamics model is developed to simulate engineering design schedule strategies, acting as a virtual decision-making platform for project managers.

title: Catalytic Acetic Acid Pretreatment Yields Surface-Acetylated CNFs
summary: Researchers developed a FeCl3-catalyzed acetic acid pretreatment to fabricate surface-acetylated cellulose nanofibrils for stabilizing Pickering emulsions and creating transparent optical composite films.

title: Model Predicts Seepage Pressure Effect on Brittle Rock Fractures
summary: A new micro-macrofracture model characterizes brittle rock dynamic compression failure under seepage pressure by integrating mechanical and chemical interactions.

title: Formation Control Framework for Discrete-Time MASs on Lie Groups
summary: An intrinsic discrete-time formation controller utilizing Cartan-Schouten connections has been developed for multiagent systems on Lie groups with provable stability guarantees.

title: Integrating Mixed Reality with Construction 4.0 Technologies
summary: A systematic review and five-layer framework evaluate integrating mixed reality with technologies like robotics and digital twins to improve on-site construction efficiency.

title: CPT-Based Framework Predicts Pile Running in Layered Soils
summary: A new cone tip resistance averaging approach improves the prediction of pile running velocity and depth in layered soils using CPT data.

title: Microcellular Foaming Produces Biobased PLA/CNF Scaffolds
summary: Fully biobased tissue engineering scaffolds were fabricated using polylactic acid reinforced with cellulose nanofibers via a microcellular injection molding process.

title: Vision-Language Framework for Early Workplace Hazard Recognition
summary: A study investigates a data-efficient vision-language framework using learnable visual prompting and LoRA to recognize workplace hazards from short video clips.

title: Mitigating EMI Challenges in Wide-Bandgap Power Converters
summary: A critical review analyzes electromagnetic interference challenges and coordinated mitigation strategies for wide-bandgap semiconductor power electronic converters.

title: Demographic Analysis of Extended Reality Research in AECO
summary: A review of 104 articles reveals participant demographic biases toward students in extended reality research for architecture, engineering, construction, and operations.

title: Identifying Train Motion Parameters from Bridge Strain Data
summary: A proposed analytical model uses structural strain monitoring data to identify train motion parameters on high-speed railway bridges.

title: Robust Implementation of 3D Hoek-Brown Criterion
summary: Researchers introduced an intermediate principal-stress coefficient to reformulate the 3D Hoek-Brown criterion for rock-mass shear strength analysis.

title: Dual-Critic ADP Control for Flexible Flapping-Wing UAVs
summary: An adaptive dynamic programming control strategy utilizing a dual-critic network achieves simultaneous vibration suppression and trajectory tracking for flapping-wing UAVs.
